If you wish to face a Jedi—|Grievous|Leave them be, Billaba…you have problems of your own.|attr=After murdering Stance, Coburn Sear joins Grievous in confronting Caleb Dume and Depa Billaba|src=}} The '''Third Battle of Mygeeto''', also known simply as the '''Battle of Mygeeto''', erupted on the [[planet]] [[Mygeeto]] during the final [[Standard month|months]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. Mygeeto, which was aligned with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], became host to a military presence from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with [[General]] [[Grievous]] and [[Colonel]] [[Coburn Sear]] overseeing a detachment from the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. The [[Galactic Republic]] was quick to respond with force, but its [[troop]]s became severely outnumbered, requiring reinforcements in the form of [[Jedi General]] [[Depa Billaba]] and her [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|battalion]] of [[clone trooper]]s. Upon their arrival on Mygeeto, Billaba and her [[Padawan]], [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]], led their [[soldier]]s to purge the Separatist [[battle droid]]s from the southern mesas. While they were doing so, a horde of [[droid]]s trapped both [[Jedi]], [[Clone Captain]] [[Styles]], and [[trooper]] [[Stance]] on a [[city]] platform. Only the [[time]]ly intervention of [[Skull Squadron]], a [[Mandalorian]] [[Squadron|unit]] led by [[Skull Leader]] [[Fenn Rau]], saved the four of them. Shortly after Billaba, Dume, and their men returned to their [[Mesa camp six|base camp]], Grievous and Sear launched an assault on their position. While Sear engaged Dume in single combat, Billaba entered into a [[lightsaber duel]] with Grievous. Sear committed [[Death|suicide]] when he incinerated himself and tried to [[Death|claim]] Dume's life alongside his own, but Dume beheaded him with his [[Kanan Jarrus' lightsaber|lightsaber]]. Dume, Styles, and [[Clone Commander]] [[Grey (clone trooper)|Grey]] then went to aid Billaba, whom Grievous had severely injured, but Grievous managed to escape. Although the Republic triumphed in the Third Battle of Mygeeto, it was not long before hostilities [[Fourth Battle of Mygeeto|reopened]] on the world during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Apologies, sir. The Jedi survived.''"
"''I am neither pleased nor surprised, Colonel…clearly, I'll have to deal with her myself.''"
"''As you wish, General Grievous.|Coburn Sear rendezvouses with Grievous on Mygeeto, after failing to defeat Depa Billaba at Kardoa|}} [[Mygeeto]] was one of the countless [[planet]]s to be drawn into the [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A frigid [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world, Mygeeto was aligned with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]],{{Databank|mygeeto|Mygeeto}} which the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] absorbed into his [[Office of the Chancellor|administration]] after a series of shakeups in the Banking Clan's leadership.{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} In [[19 BBY]], the Confederacy set its sights on Mygeeto. [[General]] [[Grievous]] brought a group of the [[Separatist Droid Army]] to the world, and he was thereafter joined by [[Colonel]] [[Coburn Sear]], who had narrowly [[Skirmish on Kardoa|escaped]] from [[Jedi General]] [[Depa Billaba]]'s [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|Republic battalion]] on the planet [[Kardoa]]. Following her victory on Kardoa, Billaba received orders from the [[Jedi High Council]] to confront the Separatist presence on Mygeeto, and she proceeded there with her [[battalion]] of [[clone trooper]]s as well as her [[Padawan]] learner, [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]]. ==The battle== ===Clash in the Southern Mesas=== {{Quote|But how did the Separatists ''find'' us there? Seemed like they were ''ready'' for us.''"
"''Indeed, the attack was surprisingly…''elaborate''. It bears further study.|Caleb Dume and Depa Billaba, while leaving the southern mesas|}} [[File:B1BattleDroidsClimbing-Kanan10.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatists droids used their superior numbers to overwhelm]] The battalion was ordered to clear the [[Southern Mesas]] of [[battle droid]]s. [[Remo]], [[Soot]], [[Big-Mouth]], [[Mixx]], and [[Kaylon]] lead [[squad]]s through the mesas. Billaba and Dume then went with [[Stance]], a [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]] Dume had befriended, and [[Clone Captain]] [[Styles]]. [[Clone Commander]] [[Grey (clone trooper)|Grey]] took the rest of the men. Despite the battle [[droid]]s outnumbering their forces, Billaba's battalion continued the mission to clear the Southern Mesas. However, Billaba, Dume, Styles, and Stance were then cut off from their [[troop]]s by the Separatists. [[B1-series battle droid]]s then came at them from all sides. Billaba then contacted Grey to be evacuated, but they would have to hold out for four [[Standard minute|minutes]], an amount of [[time]] Dume did not believe they had. Billaba, Dume and Stance were able to hold the [[droid]]s off until they were completely surrounded. However, the [[Fang-class Protectorate fighter|Fang fighters]] of [[Skull Squadron]] under [[Skull Leader]] [[Fenn Rau]] were able to destroy the battle droids attacking. Grey then arrived and evacuated them back to the Republic base camp aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Republic attack gunship]]. Billaba and Dume did not meet Rau in person nor thanked him for saving their lives. ===Ambush at the Republic base camp=== {{Quote|I defeated you once before. My mistake was not confirming your death.''"
"''You believe you ''know'' how to defeat me…but the Jedi you fought then did die…and the Jedi you face now is one you've ''never'' encountered before.''"
"''We shall see, Jedi, we shall see.|Grievous and Depa Billaba|}} [[File:GrievousBattlesDepaMygeeto-Kanan11.png|thumb|right|250px|General Grievous tries to overwhelm Depa Billaba.]] While most of the battalion was still out in the field, Billaba, Dume, Grey and Stance then returned to their [[Mesa camp six|camp]]. The camp then came under by battle droids under [[Colonel]] [[Coburn Sear]] and General Grievous. Stance was then killed by Sear's [[Electro sword]]. Sear was then confronted by Dume while Billaba [[Lightsaber combat|confronted]] Grievous. Billaba was able to cut off one of Grievous's hands before she was slashed by one of his [[lightsaber]]s, significantly injuring her. Grey and Styles then called for reinforcements, while they were fighting the battle droids. Dume continued to fight Sear. During the fight, Dume was able to damage Sear's [[Flamethrower]]. Sear then attempted to kill Dume, but his flamethrower blew up. Sear then attempted to take Dume with him but fell to his death. Dume was then found by Grey and Styles. The three of them then went to find Billaba, who was still [[Lightsaber duel|dueling]] with Grievous. As Grey and Styles open fired on Grievous Dume then went to Billaba. Grievous was then forced to retreat, but after the [[cyborg]] fled Billaba did not order a pursuit, as she had learned to live with regret a long time ago. Republic reinforcements, which included at least two Republic attack [[gunship]]s, and at least one [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], arrived to their location, and the battle was over. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|My master, Depa Billaba, and I were pinned down, trapped by droids. You and your Skull Squadron flew into the Separatist fire over and over to cover us. You saved our lives.''"
"''That was a long time ago. I was younger and more reckless then. To be honest, I don't see what that has to do with you being here.''"
"''You gave me a chance to live that day. Now I'd like to return the favor.|Kanan Jarrus, formerly Caleb Dume, speaks with Fenn Rau regarding their shared service in the Third Battle of Mygeeto|{{Rebels|The Protector of Concord Dawn}}}} Billaba, Dume and members of their battalion gave Stance a [[Funeral of Stance|funeral]]. Billaba then went into a [[bacta tank]] to recover from her wounds. Billaba, Dume and their troops were then sent to [[Kaller]]. Mere months later, the [[Fourth Battle of Mygeeto]] was fought on Mygeeto.{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|Helmets}} [[Standard year|Years]] later, Dume, now known as Kanan Jarrus, thought back on his time as a just prior to and as padawan under Billaba, and remembered the battle while in a [[Plateau City medcenter|medcenter]] in [[Plateau City]] on [[Kaller]]. He awoke in time to save the [[Spectres]], the group he was a part of, from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s. Among the group was his own padawan, [[Ezra Bridger]].{{Rebels|Path of the Jedi}} Later Jarrus [[Mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|met up]] with with Rau, now leader of the [[Journeyman Protector|Protectors]], on [[Concord Dawn]]'s [[Third moon of Concord Dawn|Third moon]]. There, Jarrus recounted to Rau how he and his Skull Squadron saved both his and Master Billaba's life that day. Kanan then attempted to recruit Rau and his Protectors into the [[Phoenix Cell|rebellion]]. At first, Rau refused to fight another losing war with the former [[Jedi]], but Rau was then captured by Jarrus and a fellow member of the Spectres, [[Sabine Wren]], who was [[Mandalorian]] like Rau. He then told his protectors to keep his capture a secret from the Galactic Empire. ==Behind the scenes== The Third Battle of Mygeeto first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Kanan 10|''Kanan'' 10]], written by [[Greg Weisman]], illustrated by [[Pepe Larraz]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[January 27]], [[2016]].{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/56104/kanan_2015_10|text=Kanan (2015) #10}} ==Appearances== *[[Kanan 10|''Kanan'' 10]] {{1st}} *[[Kanan 11|''Kanan'' 11]] *''[[Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel]]'' {{Ab|Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *{{Rebels|The Protector of Concord Dawn}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== {{SourceContents-start|{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|parent=1}}}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|Databank A-Z}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|Helmets}} {{SourceContents-end}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-protector-of-concord-dawn-episode-guide|text="The Protector of Concord Dawn" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} {{SourceContents-start|{{HelmetCollectionCite|69|parent=1}}}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|69|Helmets}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|69|Highlights of the Saga}} {{SourceContents-end}} *''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|58|History of the Ship}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|fenn-rau|Fenn Rau}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{Interlang |es=Tercera Batalla de Mygeeto |fr=Troisième bataille de Mygeeto |pl=Trzecia bitwa o Mygeeto |pt=Terceira Batalha de Mygeeto }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Mygeeto, Battle of 3}} [[Category:Battles of the Mygeeto Campaign]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
